title: Very heavy bowls, hard to maneuver for me
text:
Very heavy bowls, hard to maneuver for me. These are very nicely made pink bowls that are large enough to hold a good amount of soup or chili.
The pink swirl is very pretty as well.

For some reason, I expected these bowls to be much lighter than they are!

I don't have a lot of hand strength due to arthritis, and I find these bowls very awkward to use and wash up. Not because of the finish, but because of the sheer weight of each bowl.

They are good looking and have a nice finish, but I don't see myself using these very often. They are just too heavy and awkward for my hands.
